def univariate_profile(column_name, series, figsize=(15, 10)):
    """
    对单个列进行完整的单变量分析
    """
    profile = {}
    profile['column_name'] = column_name
    profile['data_type'] = str(series.dtype)
    profile['total_count'] = len(series)
    
    # 1. 缺失值分析
    missing_count = series.isnull().sum()
    missing_percentage = (missing_count / len(series)) * 100
    profile['missing_count'] = missing_count
    profile['missing_percentage'] = missing_percentage
    
    # 非缺失数据
    non_null_series = series.dropna()
    profile['non_null_count'] = len(non_null_series)
    
    # 2. 唯一值分析
    unique_count = non_null_series.nunique()
    unique_ratio = unique_count / len(non_null_series) if len(non_null_series) > 0 else 0
    profile['unique_count'] = unique_count
    profile['unique_ratio'] = unique_ratio
    
    # 3. 前20个最频繁的值
    if len(non_null_series) > 0:
        top_values = non_null_series.value_counts().head(20)
        profile['top_20_values'] = top_values.to_dict()
    else:
        profile['top_20_values'] = {}
    
    # 对于数值型数据，进行更详细的分析
    if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(series):
        numeric_series = pd.to_numeric(non_null_series, errors='coerce').dropna()
        
        if len(numeric_series) > 0:
            # 基本统计量
            profile['min'] = float(numeric_series.min())
            profile['max'] = float(numeric_series.max())
            profile['mean'] = float(numeric_series.mean())
            profile['median'] = float(numeric_series.median())
            profile['std'] = float(numeric_series.std())
            
            # 偏度和峰度
            if len(numeric_series) > 1 and numeric_series.std() > 0:
                profile['skewness'] = float(stats.skew(numeric_series))
                profile['kurtosis'] = float(stats.kurtosis(numeric_series))
            else:
                profile['skewness'] = None
                profile['kurtosis'] = None
            
            # IQR异常值检测
            Q1 = numeric_series.quantile(0.25)
            Q3 = numeric_series.quantile(0.75)
            IQR = Q3 - Q1
            lower_bound = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR
            upper_bound = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR
            
            iqr_outliers = numeric_series[(numeric_series < lower_bound) | (numeric_series > upper_bound)]
            profile['iqr_outliers_count'] = len(iqr_outliers)
            profile['iqr_outliers_percentage'] = (len(iqr_outliers) / len(numeric_series)) * 100
            
            # Z-score异常值检测
            if numeric_series.std() > 0:
                z_scores = np.abs((numeric_series - numeric_series.mean()) / numeric_series.std())
                z_outliers = numeric_series[z_scores > 3]
                profile['z_outliers_count'] = len(z_outliers)
                profile['z_outliers_percentage'] = (len(z_outliers) / len(numeric_series)) * 100
            else:
                profile['z_outliers_count'] = 0
                profile['z_outliers_percentage'] = 0
            
            # Isolation Forest异常值检测
            if len(numeric_series) >= 10:
                try:
                    iso_forest = IsolationForest(contamination=0.1, random_state=42)
                    X = numeric_series.values.reshape(-1, 1)
                    preds = iso_forest.fit_predict(X)
                    iso_outliers = numeric_series[preds == -1]
                    profile['iso_outliers_count'] = len(iso_outliers)
                    profile['iso_outliers_percentage'] = (len(iso_outliers) / len(numeric_series)) * 100
                except:
                    profile['iso_outliers_count'] = None
                    profile['iso_outliers_percentage'] = None
            else:
                profile['iso_outliers_count'] = None
                profile['iso_outliers_percentage'] = None
            
            # 创建可视化
            fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=figsize)
            
            # 直方图
            axes[0, 0].hist(numeric_series, bins=50, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
            axes[0, 0].set_title(f'{column_name} - 直方图')
            axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('值')
            axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('频数')
            
            # 箱线图
            axes[0, 1].boxplot(numeric_series, vert=False)
            axes[0, 1].set_title(f'{column_name} - 箱线图')
            axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('值')
            
            # Q-Q图
            if len(numeric_series) > 1:
                stats.probplot(numeric_series, dist="norm", plot=axes[1, 0])
                axes[1, 0].set_title(f'{column_name} - Q-Q图')
            
            # 密度图
            axes[1, 1].hist(numeric_series, bins=50, density=True, alpha=0.5, label='直方图')
            sns.kdeplot(numeric_series, ax=axes[1, 1], label='核密度估计')
            axes[1, 1].set_title(f'{column_name} - 密度图')
            axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('值')
            axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('密度')
            axes[1, 1].legend()
            
            plt.suptitle(f'{column_name} - 单变量分析', fontsize=16)
            plt.tight_layout()
            plt.show()
    
    return profile

    if 'mean' in profile:

        print(f"  最大值: {profile.get('max', 'N/A')}")
        print(f"  均值: {profile.get('mean', 'N/A'):.2f}")
        print(f"  中位数: {profile.get('median', 'N/A'):.2f}")
        print(f"  标准差: {profile.get('std', 'N/A'):.2f}")
        print(f"  偏度: {profile.get('skewness', 'N/A'):.2f}")
        print(f"  峰度: {profile.get('kurtosis', 'N/A'):.2f}")
        
        print(f"\n异常值检测:")
        print(f"  IQR异常值: {profile.get('iqr_outliers_count', 'N/A')} ({profile.get('iqr_outliers_percentage', 'N/A'):.2f}%)")
        print(f"  Z-score异常值: {profile.get('z_outliers_count', 'N/A')} ({profile.get('z_outliers_percentage', 'N/A'):.2f}%)")
        print(f"  Isolation Forest异常值: {profile.get('iso_outliers_count', 'N/A')} ({profile.get('iso_outliers_percentage', 'N/A'):.2f}%)")
    
    # 打印前5个最频繁的值
    if profile['top_20_values']:
        print(f"\n前5个最频繁的值:")
        top_5 = list(profile['top_20_values'].items())[:5]
        for value, count in top_5:
            print(f"  {value}: {count} ({count/profile['non_null_count']*100:.2f}%)")
    
    print(f"\n{'='*80}")

print(f"{'='*100}")

print(summary_df[['column_name', 'data_type', 'total_count', 'missing_count', 
                  'missing_percentage', 'unique_count', 'unique_ratio']].to_string())

# 对于数值型列，展示更多统计信息
numeric_cols = [p['column_name'] for p in all_profiles if 'mean' in p]
if numeric_cols:

                'column': p['column_name'],

            })
    
    numeric_summary_df = pd.DataFrame(numeric_summary)

def univariate_profile(column_name, series, figsize=(15, 10)):
    """
    对单个列进行完整的单变量分析
    """
    profile = {}
    profile['column_name'] = column_name
    profile['data_type'] = str(series.dtype)
    profile['total_count'] = len(series)
    
    # 1. 缺失值分析
    missing_count = series.isnull().sum()
    missing_percentage = (missing_count / len(series)) * 100
    profile['missing_count'] = missing_count
    profile['missing_percentage'] = missing_percentage
    
    # 非缺失数据
    non_null_series = series.dropna()
    profile['non_null_count'] = len(non_null_series)
    
    # 2. 唯一值分析
    unique_count = non_null_series.nunique()
    unique_ratio = unique_count / len(non_null_series) if len(non_null_series) > 0 else 0
    profile['unique_count'] = unique_count
    profile['unique_ratio'] = unique_ratio
    
    # 3. 前20个最频繁的值
    if len(non_null_series) > 0:
        top_values = non_null_series.value_counts().head(20)
        profile['top_20_values'] = top_values.to_dict()
    else:
        profile['top_20_values'] = {}
    
    # 对于数值型数据，进行更详细的分析
    if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(series):
        numeric_series = pd.to_numeric(non_null_series, errors='coerce').dropna()
        
        if len(numeric_series) > 0:
            # 基本统计量
            profile['min'] = float(numeric_series.min())
            profile['max'] = float(numeric_series.max())
            profile['mean'] = float(numeric_series.mean())
            profile['median'] = float(numeric_series.median())
            profile['std'] = float(numeric_series.std())
            
            # 偏度和峰度
            if len(numeric_series) > 1 and numeric_series.std() > 0:
                profile['skewness'] = float(stats.skew(numeric_series))
                profile['kurtosis'] = float(stats.kurtosis(numeric_series))
            else:
                profile['skewness'] = None
                profile['kurtosis'] = None
            
            # IQR异常值检测
            Q1 = numeric_series.quantile(0.25)
            Q3 = numeric_series.quantile(0.75)
            IQR = Q3 - Q1
            lower_bound = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR
            upper_bound = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR
            
            iqr_outliers = numeric_series[(numeric_series < lower_bound) | (numeric_series > upper_bound)]
            profile['iqr_outliers_count'] = len(iqr_outliers)
            profile['iqr_outliers_percentage'] = (len(iqr_outliers) / len(numeric_series)) * 100
            
            # Z-score异常值检测
            if numeric_series.std() > 0:
                z_scores = np.abs((numeric_series - numeric_series.mean()) / numeric_series.std())
                z_outliers = numeric_series[z_scores > 3]
                profile['z_outliers_count'] = len(z_outliers)
                profile['z_outliers_percentage'] = (len(z_outliers) / len(numeric_series)) * 100
            else:
                profile['z_outliers_count'] = 0
                profile['z_outliers_percentage'] = 0
            
            # Isolation Forest异常值检测
            if len(numeric_series) >= 10:
                try:
                    iso_forest = IsolationForest(contamination=0.1, random_state=42)
                    X = numeric_series.values.reshape(-1, 1)
                    preds = iso_forest.fit_predict(X)
                    iso_outliers = numeric_series[preds == -1]
                    profile['iso_outliers_count'] = len(iso_outliers)
                    profile['iso_outliers_percentage'] = (len(iso_outliers) / len(numeric_series)) * 100
                except:
                    profile['iso_outliers_count'] = None
                    profile['iso_outliers_percentage'] = None
            else:
                profile['iso_outliers_count'] = None
                profile['iso_outliers_percentage'] = None
            
            # 创建可视化
            fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=figsize)
            
            # 直方图
            axes[0, 0].hist(numeric_series, bins=50, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
            axes[0, 0].set_title(f'{column_name} - 直方图')
            axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('值')
            axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('频数')
            
            # 箱线图
            axes[0, 1].boxplot(numeric_series, vert=False)
            axes[0, 1].set_title(f'{column_name} - 箱线图')
            axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('值')
            
            # Q-Q图
            if len(numeric_series) > 1:
                stats.probplot(numeric_series, dist="norm", plot=axes[1, 0])
                axes[1, 0].set_title(f'{column_name} - Q-Q图')
            
            # 密度图
            axes[1, 1].hist(numeric_series, bins=50, density=True, alpha=0.5, label='直方图')
            sns.kdeplot(numeric_series, ax=axes[1, 1], label='核密度估计')
            axes[1, 1].set_title(f'{column_name} - 密度图')
            axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('值')
            axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('密度')
            axes[1, 1].legend()
            
            plt.suptitle(f'{column_name} - 单变量分析', fontsize=16)
            plt.tight_layout()
            plt.show()
    
    return profile
